title: Site Gas Plan and the Small Business Electricity Supply Grace-Period Renewal Rate: Training Questions
content:
**Site gas adjustment.** For a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement renewed inside the grace period after rollover, when the agreement's site takes Beacon Ridge commercial gas under an active Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement on a plan with a fixed term, the grace-period renewal rate is lowered by 0.08 cents per kWh; when that active gas agreement is on the month-to-month index plan, by 0.04 cents; when the site has no active Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement, it is not lowered.

**Which gas agreement is read?**
The Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement at the electricity agreement's own site, in active status, and the term of its plan.

**What lowers the rate, and by how much?**

| Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement at the site | Lowering of the grace-period renewal rate |
|---|---|
| active, plan with a fixed term (above 0 months) | 0.08 cents per kWh |
| active, month-to-month index plan | 0.04 cents per kWh |
| no active one | none |

**What about gas at another site of the same business?**
It is not the agreement's site, so it does not lower the rate.

**What about a gas agreement at the site that is enrollment pending?**
It is not active; with no active Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement at the site, the rate is not lowered.
